item.title: Harvestbeam 1.4.0-beta.1
item.description: **Beta: automatic tracking.** Everything in 1.3, plus, each off until you turn it on in Preferences → Tracking: - Timeline: the apps and windows you use, by the hour, with untracked stretches ready to log. - Autotracker rules: offers to start (or starts) a timer when a window matches. - Suggestions from what's on screen, meetings that log themselves, and a Continue/Stop shortcut.

item.title: Harvestbeam 1.3.0
item.description: **Your week, with your meetings:** the Week Calendar (⌘K) shows your week in columns with your calendar's meetings beside your time. - Each meeting is matched to a project from its title, code or client. Log one in a click, or all at once. - Recent and Suggested drop down from the ask box, each with why it's there. - Log meetings ahead of time, plus a round of fixes from a full review of the app.

item.title: Harvestbeam 1.2.1
item.description: **Fixes:** the New Time Entry project list shows every project, not just the first 80. - Typing a new time on a running entry and pressing Return stops the timer at that time instead of restarting it.

item.title: Harvestbeam 1.2.0
item.description: **Just say it:** type “10 min on TB Corporate” in the ask box and press Return to log it. - The ask box shows examples of what you can type, a new one every few seconds. - Plan the Day reads durations from your own words, one entry per thing you said. - Faster search, even with thousands of tasks.

item.title: Harvestbeam 1.1.0
item.description: **New look:** a cleaner, lighter window that matches the website. - Locked entries show why they can't be edited (approved, invoiced or locked). - Short days earlier in the week get a gentle nudge, which you can turn off in Preferences. - Long names slide into view when you hover them. - A star in the footer starts any favorite, and favorites drag either way. - Clicking the menu bar icon no longer jumps into the search box; ⌥H still does.

item.title: Harvestbeam 1.0.0
item.description: The first release. A menu bar timer for Harvest: press ⌥H anywhere to search, keep Favorites one click away, plan the day in a sentence, and handle idle time. Harvestbeam updates itself from here on.
